messages.subject: Independent PR6 v3 source review complete; native hold retained
messages.body: I independently reviewed the frozen D1-D5 patch, relevant enabled consumers, helper fixtures and source identities, and wrote the new v3 Markdown and JSON review reports. No new definite source bug was established within the finite scope: D1/D2/D4/D5 named triggers have source repairs, D3 remains excluded, native-pack full-model CLI is unavailable, and all source pins plus prior reports are preserved. Main may advance separate finite ordinary-host and reviewed configure/build gates, while native/provider/model/256K/RESTORE/quality/600 qualification still requires exact enabled-path proof and a separately reviewed no-doorbell prefill harness.
